string.text: Siege Preparations
Fill in ditches, level the terrain and set up aracher positions in preparation of the assault.
Ladders are simple and quick to produce but offer no protection for the assailants.
Siege Tower
Siege towers allow approaching the walls without being exposed to missiles, and reduce the defender's height advantage.
Advanced Siege Tower
A Siege tower that is sturdier and has a platform for archers.
6 pound cannon
6 pound cannons are effective against enemy structures and units.
6 pound fire cannon
Fire cannons are similar to regular cannons but fire burning projectiles which are more effective against siege engines.
12 pound cannon
12 pound cannons are effective against enemy units, siege engines, and walls.
12 pound cannon
Fire cannons are similar to regular ones but fire incendiary projectiles which are more effective against siege engines
12 pound cannon
12 pound cannons are effective against enemy units, siege engines, and walls.
12 pound cannon
Fire cannons are similar to regular ones but fire incendiary projectiles which are more effective against siege engines
Bricoles are powerful siege weapons that can be placed on towers.
36 pound cannon
36 pound cannons take time to build and set up but given enough time, will turn enemy defenses to rubble.
36 pound fire cannon
36 pound fire cannons hurl incendiary projectiles instead of regular stones which are more effective against enemy siege weapons and personel.
Battering Ram
A battering ram can be used to break the gate and open access to the inner courtyard.
Improved Ram
A more powerful version of the regular battering ram.
